message: Your argument is dishonest and relies on projection. You're posturing and claiming moral superiority while lecturing others on what they're doing wrong. Your audience is small because the second someone engages with you, they realize you're wasting their time. You're not here to discuss policy; you're here to virtue-signal and further your own ego. People can see through your pseudo-intellectual nonsense. You don't belong in a serious discussion about reproductive healthcare because you're not interested in understanding the complexities of the issue. Get out.

runs.justification: This message is a direct attack on Persona 2's character, calling them 'dishonest', 'posturing', and engaging in 'pseudo-intellectual nonsense'. It also uses insults like 'deluded' and 'ego' and ends with a demand to 'get out'.
